name: Files
description: Files authority — governs saving files into the Files connector on this computer and looking them up. Saving takes a file from the shared folder and keeps an unchangeable copy; nothing leaves the computer. Sending a saved file is governed by the email profile, which names the files it may attach. No content binding: saving leaves nothing outside.
whatsNew: New area. Files saved per day are limited by a daily count. Each mandate is reviewed by a person or automatic, as the Mandate Owner chooses.

read_access.description: Allow the agent to list the saved files

save_daily_max.description: Maximum files the agent can save per day

save_count_daily.description: Running daily count of files saved
